No front door

Followers stay followers

A mom can save your posts for a year and never join an email list. Every day without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

One call, then start again

Your coaching is sold one call at a time. Each call ends and the next client has to be found from scratch, so income resets every month.

Products in a drawer

Your Blueprint waits to be found

The Blueprint and the Summer Reset only sell when someone clicks through your bio. Nothing puts them in front of a mom at the moment she's most ready for them.

The moms who love your posts but aren't ready to book a call today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

My recommendation

A free masterclass that sells your Blueprint and fills a coaching program

You already have the audience, the story and the products. What's missing is one free 60-minute class that teaches how you see ADHD and dyslexia through your child's eyes, offers your Struggling to Thriving Blueprint straight after sign-up, and invites the right moms to apply for coaching. Meta ads then put that class in front of new moms every day, and Blueprint sales help cover the ad spend.

Audience + Meta ads30.8k on Instagram, plus new moms reached by ads
Free masterclass"Through Their Eyes", 60 minutes, live with replay
Blueprint upsellyour Struggling to Thriving Blueprint, [$47]
Applicationon the replay page, then a call

Fixes the missing front door

One class becomes the link in your bio and the destination for your ads. Every sign-up is an email you own, and every one of them has raised her hand for help.

Fixes the missing qualifier

The replay page invites moms who want hands-on support to apply. You only talk to people who watched, learned how you work, and told you what they need.

Turns calls into a program

Instead of one a la carte call, qualified moms are offered a coaching package [~$3k] with a clear start and finish, so each client is worth far more and you need fewer of them.

The 95%*

Not ready for coaching yet

They watch the free class, buy your Blueprint on the thank-you page, and keep learning from your emails and your community. They pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready for hands-on support

They show up live, stay to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up for coaching.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"The sentence worth retiring"

Hook
"If homework time keeps ending in tears, there's one sentence worth retiring tonight." (to camera, against a bright mustard wall like your profile photo)
Body
"It's 'just try harder.' For a lot of kids who learn differently, they already are trying, harder than anyone sees. When moms start looking at homework through their child's eyes, they stop pushing and start changing the set-up. That's what I teach." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I'm walking moms through the whole approach in a free live class called Through Their Eyes. Tap Sign up to save a seat. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before you react"

Hook
"Before the next hard moment turns into a shouting match, try asking these three questions." (Heather holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: is this a won't, or a can't right now? Two: what happened just before? Three: what one change would make this easier tomorrow? The answers change the whole conversation." (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go through the full approach in my free masterclass for moms, Through Their Eyes. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start"

Hook
"Moms ask me where to start: my posts, my Blueprint, or a coaching call. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"If you're new here, don't pick yet. Come to my free live class first. You'll learn how I look at the hard moments, try a few things that week, and know which next step fits your family."
CTA
"It's called Through Their Eyes, it's free, and there's a replay if bedtime gets in the way. Tap Sign up."
